supervisor_decisions.title: Slice-Timing Correction (STC) Policy
supervisor_decisions.description: Formally specify policy for slice-timing correction across prospective acquisitions and retrospective cohorts with variable TR and multiband acceleration.

supervisor_decisions.title: Susceptibility Distortion Correction (SDC) Architecture
supervisor_decisions.description: Establish architecture for B0 field inhomogeneity unwarping: dual-phase EPI (TOPUP), phase-difference fieldmaps, or syn-b0 synthetic fallback.

supervisor_decisions.title: Facial Defacing Methodology & Anonymization
supervisor_decisions.description: Authorize facial defacing protocol ensuring complete biometric defacing while mathematically guaranteeing zero cortical gray matter or frontal-pole tissue erosion.

supervisor_decisions.title: Prospective MRI Acquisition Protocol Parameters
supervisor_decisions.description: Specify formal MRI scanner sequence parameters (field strength 3T, 32-channel head coil, 1mm T1w MP-RAGE, 3mm rs-fMRI EPI, TR, TE, FA, run duration) to avoid domain shift.

supervisor_decisions.title: T1w Brain Extraction Volume Thresholds
supervisor_decisions.description: Acceptance criteria for total intracranial brain volume (biological validity range: 600 to 2200 cm³).

supervisor_decisions.title: EPI-to-T1w Coregistration Normalized Mutual Information
supervisor_decisions.description: Acceptance threshold for rigid functional-to-structural alignment (NMI >= 0.55).

supervisor_decisions.title: T1w-to-MNI SyN Spatial Normalization Dice Overlap
supervisor_decisions.description: Acceptance threshold for non-linear symmetric diffeomorphic registration overlap with MNI152 template (Dice >= 0.85).

supervisor_decisions.title: Mean Framewise Displacement Head Motion Ceiling
supervisor_decisions.description: Acceptance ceiling for average head motion across resting-state run (mean FD <= 0.50 mm).

supervisor_decisions.title: Maximum Motion Spike Thresholds
supervisor_decisions.description: Thresholds for instantaneous head movement spikes (flag > 3.0 mm, reject run if max spike > 5.0 mm).

supervisor_decisions.title: Scrubbing / Censoring Proportion Upper Bound
supervisor_decisions.description: Maximum allowable percentage of censored/scrubbed volumes (<= 30% of total volumes in run).

supervisor_decisions.title: Temporal Signal-to-Noise Ratio (tSNR)
supervisor_decisions.description: Acceptance standard for functional scanner signal stability (median tSNR >= 40, flag if < 30).

supervisor_decisions.title: DVARS Outlier Metric Threshold
supervisor_decisions.description: Upper bound on intensity transition variance (reject volumes exceeding 1.5 * median DVARS).

institutional_legal.title: Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) Clearance
institutional_legal.description: Formal written ethics committee approval letter with registered protocol number and validity dates for pediatric computational neuroimaging.

institutional_legal.title: Data Use Agreement (DUA) Execution for ADHD-200
institutional_legal.description: Executed Data Use Agreement through NITRC / INDI covering authorized research personnel and prohibiting subject re-identification.

institutional_legal.title: Informed Consent & Pediatric Assent Protocols
institutional_legal.description: Documented parental informed consent and developmentally tailored participant assent protocols (or institutional secondary-use waiver).

institutional_legal.title: ICMR 2017 & DPDP Act 2023 Statutory Secondary-Use Compliance Review
institutional_legal.description: Institutional legal and bioethics review certifying adherence to ICMR 2017 guidelines for pediatric research and DPDP Act 2023 Section 9 child data provisions.

institutional_legal.title: Institutional Data Protection & Privacy Review
institutional_legal.description: Institutional Data Protection Officer audit verifying data fiduciary obligations, purpose limitation, and storage limitation under Indian statutory mandates.

operational_safeguards.title: De-Identification Protocol & DICOM Header Scrubbing
operational_safeguards.description: Removal of 18 HIPAA Safe Harbor identifiers and Indian statutory identifiers (Aadhaar, hospital ID, patient registration number) with DICOM tag scrubbing.

operational_safeguards.title: Facial Defacing Execution & Frontal-Pole Preservation Audit
operational_safeguards.description: Automated volumetric verification confirming 0% intersection between defacing mask and cortical gray matter mask across all anatomical volumes.

operational_safeguards.title: AES-256 Storage Encryption at Rest & Memory Ceiling Audit
operational_safeguards.description: Verification of AES-256 encrypted storage partition and operating-system-enforced 2.5 GB Linux cgroup memory limit with kernel OOM killer enabled.

operational_safeguards.title: Access-Control Least-Privilege & Non-Root Container Execution
operational_safeguards.description: Enforcement of least-privilege role-based access control, unprivileged container execution (UID 10001 'neuro'), and read-only host mounts.

operational_safeguards.title: Security Incident & Data Breach Response Procedure
operational_safeguards.description: Approved standard operating procedure for breach containment, risk assessment, and statutory notification to Data Protection Board of India / IEC within 72 hours.

operational_safeguards.title: Approved Pilot Scope & Feasibility Sample Size Authorization
operational_safeguards.description: Formal authorization of First Research Pilot Protocol (DOC-NA-A5-FRP-001) defining sample size (N=6 retrospective scans) for technical feasibility only.
